behaviors_asserted: A global middleware's Variables (e.g., remoteIp) are not available in mounted Hono instances.
A middleware's Variables type bound to a nested/mounted Hono instance (e.g., jwtPayload) is visible in unrelated Hono instances.
Provide a utility type ExtractEnv that extracts the Env generic from a Hono instance.
Users should manually pass the extracted Env to mounted Hono instances; documentation should at least hint that such a helper can be used.
